description: Cuts the signal into blocks, runs a Walsh-Hadamard transform on each one, hands the lowest sixteen coefficients out on sliders and jacks, and transforms whatever comes back into audio again

params.text: Sets the gain of that coefficient, -1 to +1, starting at +1; touch nothing and the round trip is exact to float precision
Sets the output gain, 0 to 2, unity at noon
Sets how many samples go into one block, 16 to 512, which is how far the sixteen coefficients reach up the signal
Keeps only the largest coefficients by magnitude, from all of them at one end of its travel down to one at the other
Coarsens every coefficient to a grid, from off at one end of its travel to two levels at the other
Crossfades between the dry signal, delayed to match, and the reconstruction
Chooses what happens to the coefficients above the sixteen on the panel: pass lets them through untouched, mute throws them away
Steps that coefficient's slider round three landmarks: the first press always lands on zero, the next on -1 and the next back on +1; nothing else moves

inputs.text: That coefficient on the way back in; it is a true insert return, so the slider gain has already been applied and this value is not multiplied by it again

outputs.text: The reconstruction, crossfaded with the dry signal
The delayed dry signal minus the reconstruction, which rests at zero while nothing is changed
All sixteen coefficients as their own contributions to the audio, on one sixteen-channel cable
That coefficient, one mono jack per column, at every block size

notes: this is not a spectral analyser. A Walsh coefficient describes the sign structure of a short block rather than a frequency band, so expect blockiness and grit.
with the menu on Replace and nothing in the audio jack, the sixteen coefficient inputs are a waveform in voltages, rebuilt as stacked square waves once per block.
menu: Coeff in mode — what happens to the coefficients you have not patched, once at least one is patched: Overlay (absent channels stay internal) or Replace (absent channels become zero)
